variants.title: 轻Q精细立绘
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished 2D anime character visual-development image of the SAME blue-haired whale maid girl shown in the two provided references, for a future interactive virtual character called 大肥鱼.
Reference image 1 is the primary identity, face, emotion and soft-shaded visual-quality reference. Reference image 2 is the small compact silhouette, joyful movement and thick whale-tail reference. These are two views of the same character, not two characters.
User direction: keep her petite and charming, but reduce the excessively round-headed, flat sticker-like super-deformed look. The desired effect is refined anime animation: convincing volume, nuanced eyes and mouth, flowing layered hair, soft painted shadows and a sense of presence. Do NOT redesign her as a generic maid.
Identity locks: muted indigo/navy hair gently grading to cooler blue at the ends, long loose wavy locks with relatively light tapered ends, the curved ahoge, lateral whale-fin ears with pale inner edges, small blue bows by the ears, white pleated maid headband, blue eyes, modest high-collared dark navy and white maid dress with restrained lace and subtle small gold trim, dark bow and round small collar ornament, thick curved dark whale tail ending in two whale flukes. Preserve recognisable hairline, bangs and ear placement of reference 1. No added cat/fox ears, horns, wings, different costumes, elaborate new gold embroidery or new hair accessories.
Fine restrained contours, sophisticated soft cel shading with painted gradients and subtle ambient occlusion, coherent facial anatomy, delicate blush rather than large pink circles, detailed expressive irises rather than giant toy eyes. Fully clothed, natural modest pose. No text, labels, comparison grids, logos, HUD, watermarks or UI. One character only.

Asset type: full-body proportion and style study, portrait composition.
Pose: relaxed standing three-quarter-front facing the viewer; both hands naturally visible and relaxed, feet and complete headband, hair and tail inside the frame with generous margin.
Proportion: a stylized petite anime character around three heads tall, a slightly smaller head and a more naturally connected neck, shoulders and limbs than a two-head-tall meme mascot. Still compact and cute, never realistic adult fashion-illustration proportions.
Expression: open blue eyes, attentive gentle expression with a tiny natural smile, soft focused gaze, no tears.
Scene: simple muted warm-gray studio backdrop with a faint floor shadow, nothing else. Soft neutral light with restrained warm rim light. Avoid bright white overexposure and plastic toy surfaces.
The key is a clean, well-observed full-body design of the reference girl with the subtle face and hair rendering of reference 1, suitable for judging her consistent appearance before Live2D separation.
